# Release Notes: Disruption February 13, 2026

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience on the Disruption platform.

## Enhancements

### Enhanced Keyboard Accessibility for Bulk Delete

* Keyboard-only users can now fully use Bulk Delete in:

  * Analysis
  * Matching Configuration
  * Processing Files
  * Utilization Files
* Using the Tab key now moves the focus to each individual item checkbox in sequence.
* A visible focus indicator is shown on the currently focused element.
* Users can now select and delete specific items using only the keyboard, without needing a mouse.

## Fixes

### Fixed Disruption module performance issue

Disruption production performance has improved in the following ways:

* Disruption module now loads significantly faster.
* Reduced occurrences of timeouts and intermittent errors when accessing Disruption.
* Provides a more scalable and stable experience as data volume increases.

### Resolved Amount Paid discrepancies on Providers page

The **In Network + Out of Network Amount Paid** on the **Providers** page now correctly reflects the totals from the underlying utilization file and exports when providers are manually matched during a disruption analysis.
